title: Zero-length advice equals deterministic time
statement: Let $T : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ satisfy $n+1 \le T(n)$ for every natural number $n$. Then the class of languages decidable with advice of length zero in time bounded by a constant multiple of $T$ equals the deterministic time class defined by $T$.
